name: travel
description: The travel route of the #184 baseline: about 23,800 units on foot at running speed (400 units per second, about 59 seconds) from the Riverwood road start north-east over the hills towards Whiterun, across 8 cell borders (9 cells, grid 4,-12 to 7,-7) in Tamriel. Exterior only. The frame-time goal while travelling is measured on this route and tuned against it; check.json is the held-out route.
notes: Start (19600, -46650) is the start of the Riverwood road, in grid 4,-12.

The first 6,000 units follow the road's direction (north-east) to about (23900, -42300); a straight line along the road's remaining chunks crosses a river bed that lies below its cell's water level (terrain -421 against water -250 at about (24200, -39500)), where a camera that follows the terrain would be under water, so the later waypoints go around it.

Chosen from the converted world database (terrain heights and per-cell water heights, read-only): every point of the route is at least 40 units above the cell's water level, and the terrain slope between 16-unit samples is at most about 40 degrees, with short steeper steps.
The route ends on the hills south-east of Whiterun, about 24,000 units from the city gate. Whiterun itself is a separate worldspace and not part of the route.
Eye height 120 units above the terrain is about a standing eye in Skyrim units.
